meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: Sweden v Australia | Play-off for third place | FIFA Women's World Cup Australia & New Zealand 2023™ | Full Match Replay, A LOOK BACK, A Look Back, The Story of the 2006 FIFA World Cup | The Official Film of the 2006 FIFA World Cup™, England v Senegal | Round of 16 | FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022™ | Full Match Replay
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
